messages:
noah: Hey team — spotted cache-savings moving between routes in daily rollups when sessions cross slab boundaries. customer flagged it.

lexi: Saw that in staging after the prefetch change. Prefetch tokens land in slab A, hits in slab B -> savings show up under different route.

rahul: Econ currently returns slab-keyed aggregates only (`billing_window_start`). No session linkage.

dina: Can't change invoice semantics. Suggest we emit an optional `session_attributed` annotation on rows so UI can show session-attributed view without changing slab totals.

noah: Agree. Minimal server change and preserves billing. UI can show "raw slab" vs "session attributed" columns with toggle.

lexi: Perf caveat: exact session attribution is heavy. Proposal: 1% sampling of sessions to build session map and extrapolate; show a "sampled" badge when used.

rahul: I'll prototype proto response: `{ "slab_start": 6155550000, "route_id": "r-9", "prefetch": 1200, "hits": 1100, "session_attributed": true }` (annotation only).

dina: UX: small tooltip explaining invoice numbers use raw slab totals and session view is advisory. I'll mock the toggle.

deploy-bot: deploy: econ-prefetch migration scheduled to staging in ~10m: https://deploys.internal/redwood/8801

noah: Plan: rahul -> proto PR with annotated rows; lexi -> run 7-day sampling sim and report bias; dina -> mock toggle + tooltip. Sync tomorrow 10am.
